Mystery.Name: Name
Mystery.GoalPlaceholder: What does the Crew need to find out?
Mystery.GmNotes: GM notes (clue chain, suspects, the truth...)
Mystery.SolveConfirm: Set Complexity to 0 and declare the case solved?
Mystery.ShareHint: Players need Observer permission to see the mystery and make checks.

Fumble.autopsy: The body is damaged. Further Evidence Checks involving the body are made at −4.
Fumble.chemical: The sample is destroyed. It cannot be analyzed again without another sample.
Fumble.digital: The device is Destroyed and must be repaired before further investigation.
Fumble.forensics: A crucial piece of evidence is Destroyed Beyond Repair and cannot provide further information.
Fumble.interrogation: The Check cannot be tried again by any member of the Crew.
Fumble.tailing: The subject becomes aggressive or scared, as appropriate.

Obstacle.Subtitle: {name} — {mystery}
Obstacle.ApplyExplain: For obstacles resolved in play or in a scene. Overcoming costs 1d6 Focus; failing costs 2d6.

Hint.Title: Ask for a hint
Hint.Explain: Feeling aimless? Make a DV15 Deduction Check. It costs 1d6 Focus either way; on a success the GM hints where another Clue might be found.
Hint.SuccessText: The GM will point to where another Clue might be found.
Hint.FailureText: A lot of mental strain, no new ideas.
Hint.GmTitle: Hint for the GM to reveal
Hint.GmNoPrepared: No prepared hints. Tell the Crew where another Clue might be found.

Clock.LabelPlaceholder: E.g.: Deliver the ransom before dawn

Check.NoRevealText: The Crew adds another piece to the puzzle.
Check.FailureText: The clue didn't make sense this time.
Check.AlreadyCollected: Someone else had already collected this clue.
Check.DebunkedText: It isn't a Clue, for this mystery at least.
Check.PenaltyNote: {value} penalty from an earlier fumble on this clue.

Focus.Label: Focus
Focus.Tooltip: Focus = 10 + 5 × (INT + WILL) ÷ 2, rounded up. At 0 you can't make Evidence Checks.

Rest.Title: Rest for a day
Rest.Explain: {name} spends the day doing nothing else (no Hustling or Role Abilities) and recovers INT + WILL Focus.
Rest.Concentration: Make a DV15 Concentration Check to recover +5

Day.Label: Day
Day.Hint: Each character can make one Evidence Check per Clue per day. The day follows world time and the New day button.
Day.NewHint: Advance the day and allow new checks
Day.NewText: Day {day}: Evidence Checks are open again.

Editor.Name: Name
Editor.SkillHelp: System skill names in English, comma separated. Use {role} for Role Abilities and {science} for any Science.
Editor.RedHerringHint: Players see a normal clue. Beating the DV reveals it's false; failing costs Focus like a regular failure.
Editor.RevealPlaceholder: What is revealed when someone passes the check. Accepts @UUID links.
Editor.ObstacleHint: Leave skills empty to resolve it in play and apply the result with the gavel button.

Dialog.SystemDialogNote: The system roll dialog opens next, with LUCK and modifiers.
Dialog.ConfirmDelete: Really delete? This cannot be undone.

ShowDv.Name: Show DVs to players
ShowDv.Hint: When off, only the GM sees clue and obstacle DVs.

ComplexityDisplay.Name: Complexity for players
ComplexityDisplay.Hint: How players see the remaining Complexity of mysteries.

TiesSucceed.Name: Meeting the DV counts as success
TiesSucceed.Hint: Cyberpunk RED rules require beating the DV. Turn on if your table succeeds on a tie.

MookFocus.Name: Focus for NPCs (mooks)
MookFocus.Hint: Also show Focus on mook sheets and let NPCs investigate.

UseWorldTime.Name: Use world time for days
UseWorldTime.Hint: The one-check-per-clue-per-day limit follows Foundry world time, plus the New day button.

Error.NoGM: A GM must be logged in to resolve checks.
Error.Timeout: The GM didn't answer in time.
Error.NoActor: No character available. Select your character's token.
Error.NoFocus: {name} has no Focus and can't make Evidence Checks until resting.
Error.AlreadyTried: {name} already tried this today. Try again another day.
Error.WrongSystem: The Investigation module only works with the Cyberpunk RED - CORE system.
Error.AdapterFailed: Investigation: couldn't load parts of the Cyberpunk RED system. Rolls won't work.
Error.ImportFirst: Import this mystery into the world (right-click → Import) to use it.
